item.title: Brahma Kumaris - The gentle shakti of BK Mohini Didi
item.description: BK Mohini Panjabi has been appointed as the Administrative and Spiritual Head of the Brahma Kumaris, the sixth female elder to lead this global movement since its founding in 1936. Journeying from post-Partition India to leading The Brahma Kumaris, BK Mohini Didi’s visionary leadership continues to make spirituality tangible, accessible, and deeply relevant. item.title: Brahma Kumaris - World Meditation Day Event at the House of Lords, UK
item.description: UK House of Lords hosted UN World Meditation Day event with Sister Jayanti. MPs, diplomats and leaders explored meditation for well-being and social harmony.

item.title: Brahma Kumaris - World Meditation Day, Indonesia
item.description: World Meditation Day 2025 celebrated in Jakarta with 1,300 participants at Murugan Temple, featuring Didi Sudesh, Joint Administrative Head of Brahma Kumaris.

item.title: Brahma Kumaris - Participation in a radio program on the University of Costa Rica Radio
item.description: Brahma Kumaris Costa Rica participated in a radio discussion on democratic coexistence after elections, promoting spiritual values to rebuild social fabric.

item.title: Brahma Kumaris - News from Quito, Ecuador
item.description: During the week of Interfaith Harmony, sister Ana López represented the Brahma Kumaris participated in a very solemn act organized by FPU (Federation for the Universal Peace), together with representatives of different religions. The main theme was “How do religions contribute in a practical way to peace in the world?” Each representative shared their views as a contribution to world peace. item.title: Brahma Kumaris - President of India launches Campaign ‘Karmayoga for Empowered Bharat
item.description: Smt. Droupadi Murmu, The Hon’ble President of India launched All India Conference and Launch of National Campaign ‘Karmayoga for Empowered Bharat (India)'. Mrs Droupadi Murmu, The Hon. President of India, spoke at the launch of the 'Karmayoga for Empowered Bharat' initiative at Vigyan Bhavan, New Delhi, India - an event organised by the Brahma Kumaris.
